tools.name: list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads (sales pipeline) for the signed-in user, most recently updated first. Filter by stage, status, destination, agent, free-text search, trip start range or last update. Each row includes totals, deposit and the TCC lead URL.

stage.description: Pipeline stage code or label — see list_lead_stages.

status.description: Internal status: new, proposal_sent, negotiation, won, lost.

search.description: Free text: lead code, client name or email.

agent.description: Assigned agent full name or email.

trip_start_from.description: Trip starts on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

trip_start_to.description: Trip starts on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated_since.description: Only leads updated after this ISO date/time.

tools.name: get_lead
tools.title: Get lead detail
tools.description: Get a single lead with its planner and costing data. Look it up by lead id (uuid) or by lead code — 'YT5130', 'YT-5130' and the internal 'YT-2026-5130' all work.

tools.name: list_lead_stages
tools.title: List lead stages
tools.description: List the exact pipeline stages a lead can be set to (code + label + group). Call this before update_lead_stage or before filtering list_leads by stage, so stage strings are never guessed.

tools.name: update_lead_stage
tools.title: Update lead stage
tools.description: Move a lead to another pipeline stage, exactly like the stage dropdown in the lead header. Mirrors the stage to NetHunt when the lead is linked and records the change in the lead history. Use list_lead_stages for valid values.

stage.description: Target stage code or label, e.g. 'SALES · Final Negotiation & Ready to Book'.

note.description: Optional reason stored with the history entry.

tools.name: assign_lead_agents
tools.title: Assign lead agents
tools.description: Assign up to two TCC users as the agents of a lead, exactly like the 'Atribuir até 2 agentes' popup. Accepts a full name or an email; pass null to clear a slot.

agent_1.description: First agent: full name or email. null clears it.

agent_2.description: Second agent: full name or email. null clears it.

tools.name: update_lead_general_data
tools.title: Update lead general data
tools.description: Update the general data of the LIVE version of a lead (dates, participants, language, client type, phone, category, destination), exactly like saving Dados Gerais in the TCC. Participants and dates are propagated to the travel plan and digital proposal. No financial fields.

idioma.description: Programme language: en, pt, es, fr, it, de.

tools.name: add_lead_note
tools.title: Add internal lead note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a lead. The note shows in the lead history/timeline and is replicated as a NetHunt comment when the lead is linked. Notes are internal — nothing is sent to the client.

pin.description: Pin the note at the top of the lead notes.

tools.name: get_travel_plan
tools.title: Get travel plan
tools.description: Read the commercial programme of a lead: title, summary, day-by-day (date, title, tagline, included items, night at), hotels and the public link of the digital itinerary. Use this to write client emails without opening the TCC.

tools.name: export_travel_plan_pdf
tools.title: Export travel plan PDF
tools.description: Generate the client-facing Travel Plan PDF of a lead server-side (cover, day-by-day with images and route maps, hotels, pricing, terms, reviews, B2B logo when set), store it privately and return a signed download link valid for 7 days plus warnings about days missing maps or images.

language.description: Override the programme language (en, pt, es, fr, it, de).

hide_optionals.description: Hide optional experiences from the pricing block.

tools.name: list_upcoming_trips
tools.title: List upcoming trips
tools.description: List confirmed trips departing within the next N days, soonest first. Use for operational priorities (D-1, D-3, D-7).

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List operational and sales tasks, optionally filtered by status, team or lead.

status.description: Filter by task status, e.g. todo, doing, done.

team.description: Filter by team, e.g. sales or ops.

lead_id.description: Only tasks linked to this lead uuid.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create an operational or sales task for the signed-in user. Keep titles short and actionable.

priority.description: Priority, e.g. low, medium, high, urgent.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: Update an existing task. Provide task_id plus only the fields to change, e.g. set status to done.

status.description: New status: todo, in_progress, blocked or done.

priority.description: Priority, e.g. low, medium, high, urgent.

tools.name: list_pending_approvals
tools.title: List AI approval queue
tools.description: List the actions waiting for human approval in the TCC (client emails, supplier/FSE emails, payment links). Agents propose these actions; a person approves, edits or rejects them in the 'Aprovações AI' page and only then are they executed.

lead_code.description: Only items of this lead (code such as YT5130).

tools.name: get_approval_status
tools.title: Get AI approval status
tools.description: Check what happened to one item of the AI approval queue: still pending, approved, rejected, executed (with the result, such as the payment link URL or the sent email) or failed (with the error).

approval_id.description: Id returned when the action was queued.

tools.name: get_costing
tools.title: Get costing
tools.description: Read the costing of a lead: lines per day (service, supplier/FSE, unit cost, quantity, pax type, markup, selling price, optional yes/no), totals, margin, total YT, deposited and outstanding. Day 0 is the accommodation block.

tools.name: upsert_costing_lines
tools.title: Create or update costing lines
tools.description: Create or update costing lines of a lead, exactly like editing the Custos table in the TCC. Totals and profit are recalculated with the same arithmetic. The save is refused when the resulting margin drops below the company minimum, and the answer flags when the file needs CEO approval because it is above the approval threshold.

day_number.description: Day of the programme (0 = accommodation block).

day_title.description: Day title, used when the day row does not exist yet.

line_id.description: Existing line id — omit to create a new line.

pricing_type.description: How the net price is expressed.

num_adults.description: Adults (or number of nights when pricing_type is per_night).

price_adults.description: Net price per adult, per night, or the net total.

margin_percent.description: Markup percentage applied to the net cost.

status.description: Line state; 'opcionais' keeps it out of the base totals.

tools.name: remove_costing_line
tools.title: Remove a costing line
tools.description: Remove one line from the costing of a lead, like deleting a row in the Custos table. Only costing lines are affected — leads, versions and travel plans are never deleted by MCP tools.

day_number.description: Day holding the line (0 = accommodation block).

tools.name: autofill_costing_from_plan
tools.title: Auto-fill costing from the travel plan
tools.description: Build or complete the costing of a lead from its travel plan and the FSE protocols, exactly like the auto-import button in Custos. Existing lines keep their id and only empty rates are filled; nothing is deleted. Review the totals and margin afterwards.

seed_missing_lines.description: Create one costing line per programme item that has none yet (default true).

tools.name: get_operations
tools.title: Get operations board
tools.description: Read the operations board of a lead: services per day with supplier/FSE, booking status, payment status, invoice status, schedule, pax, net value, and the operational trip briefing (pickup hotel, flights, on-site contacts, special requests).

tools.name: update_operation_item
tools.title: Update an operations service
tools.description: Update one service on the operations board of a lead: booking status, payment status, invoice status, schedule, supplier, pax, net value, the supplier confirmation number and notes. Uses the same states as the Operações tab.

tools.name: update_trip_briefing
tools.title: Update the operational trip briefing
tools.description: Store the operational briefing of a trip: pickup hotel, arrival and departure flights, on-site contacts, and special requests. Only the fields sent are changed; the others keep their current value. Read it back with get_operations.

pickup_hotel.description: Hotel or address where the guide picks the clients up.

on_site_contacts.description: Phone numbers / contacts on the ground.

special_requests.description: Dietary needs, mobility, celebrations, anything the guide must know.

tools.name: validate_lead
tools.title: Validate a lead before the next stage
tools.description: Checklist for one lead: required fields still missing, inconsistencies (dates vs number of days, pax vs costing, programme language vs client language, B2B without partner/logo), costing and margin health, and what is still needed before moving to the next pipeline stage.

tools.name: generate_travel_plan
tools.title: Generate the travel plan with AI
tools.description: Generate the day-by-day programme of a lead with the same AI generator used by 'Regenerar Tudo' in the Travel Planner. If the LIVE version already has a programme, a NEW version is created and becomes LIVE — the previous one stays readable, nothing is overwritten. Returns the programme plus the warnings to fix before sending it to the client.

briefing.description: Briefing / extra instructions for the AI (client wishes, pace, must-sees).

catalogue_products.description: Catalogue product names to include in the programme.

force_new_version.description: Always create a new version, even if the live one is empty.

tools.name: update_travel_plan_day
tools.title: Edit, add, remove or reorder a programme day
tools.description: Edit one day of the travel plan (title, tagline, included items, night at, date, map), or add, remove and reorder days. Writes the same rows as the Travel Planner, so the digital itinerary and the PDF follow immediately.

action.description: What to do with the day.

day_number.description: Day to act on (for 'add', the position of the new day).

map_url.description: Google Maps route link for this day.

tools.name: update_travel_plan_header
tools.title: Update the programme header
tools.description: Update the header of the travel plan: title, subtitle/tagline, summary text and cover image. Same effect as editing the top of the Travel Planner, reflected in the digital itinerary and in the PDF.

tools.name: fill_travel_plan_images
tools.title: Fill programme images
tools.description: Fill the missing images of the programme (cover and each day) with the same image search used by 'Preencher Imagens (AI)' in the Travel Planner. Days that already have images are left untouched unless overwrite is set.

overwrite.description: Replace images that already exist (default false).

tools.name: request_payment_link
tools.title: Request a payment link (human approval required)
tools.description: Propose a WeTravel payment link for a lead. The link is NOT created here: the request is placed in the 'Aprovações AI' queue with the amount, deposit and description. When a person approves it, the existing 'Criar link de pagamento' logic runs and the link is saved on the lead. Amounts default to the base selling price (optionals excluded), as in the UI.

kind.description: What to charge: 25% deposit, 50% deposit, full amount, the optionals, or a custom amount.

amount_eur.description: Amount in EUR — required for 'custom', otherwise computed.

description.description: Description shown to the client on the checkout page.

tools.name: draft_fse_requests
tools.title: Draft supplier (FSE) booking requests — human approval required
tools.description: Draft the Portuguese availability/booking request emails to each supplier (FSE) of a lead, in the format the TCC already uses and with the correct YT reference. One queue item per supplier is created in 'Aprovações AI'; no email is sent until a human approves it.

only_pending.description: Only suppliers whose services are not booked yet (default true).

tools.name: draft_client_email
tools.title: Draft a client email — human approval required
tools.description: Draft a client email with the AI Email Composer (house style, clickable cover, day-by-day, Book Now), optionally attaching the travel plan PDF. The email is placed in the 'Aprovações AI' queue: nothing is sent until a human approves it, and it is then sent from reservas@yourtours.pt and logged in Comunicações and NetHunt.

notes.description: Notes for the AI: what to emphasise, what changed, tone hints.

language.description: Email language (default: the client language on the lead).

attach_travel_plan_pdf.description: Attach the travel plan PDF (default false).

tools.name: import_lead_ai
tools.title: Create a lead from a client email (AI Import)
tools.description: Create a new lead from the raw client request, using the same AI extraction as 'Nova Lead → AI Import'. Assigns the next YT code and starts at 'SALES · New Lead'. Deduplicates: if a lead with the same client email and overlapping dates exists, nothing is created and that lead is returned with duplicate=true.

sender_email.description: Sender email (used when the text has none).

gmail_thread_id.description: Gmail message/thread id, stored in the notes.

language.description: Client language, e.g. EN, PT, FR.
